notes.subject: landscape
notes.text: Green tropical mountains with many palm trees, on a small Pacific island group east of Fiji.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: Small roads are often made of concrete.

notes.subject: architecture
notes.text: Mostly one-storey houses with a simple box design and plain metal sheet roofs.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: On the main island, the most common coverage shows a slightly rusted black truck bed.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: The front of a silver-grey truck with side mirrors appears on the two eastern islands linked by a bridge.

notes.subject: car
notes.text: On the easternmost covered island, a similar truck is glossy black with side mirrors visible.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: A single-lane bridge between two eastern islands has a thin wire guardrail and an island on each side.

notes.subject: other
notes.text: A small airport with a concrete runway, covered by a car with two orange straps on the roof and many palms beyond the runway.
